title: Consultation & Service Engagement | Lalitpur Advisory
metaDescription: Discover our structured 4-stage financial consultation process in Nepal. Initial discovery, diagnostic audit, strategic roadmap, and monthly review.
directAnswer: Our financial consultation process follows a proven four-stage lifecycle: an initial 45-minute discovery consultation, a detailed diagnostic audit of historical records, the formulation of a strategic roadmap with quantifiable deliverables, and ongoing monthly review sessions to track progress.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Operations

sections.contentHtml:
1

Diagnostic Discovery Call (45 Minutes)

We evaluate historical balance sheets, current cash flow bottlenecks, tax status, and growth objectives to identify your organizational scale.

2

Engagement Scope & Terms of Reference

We define clear milestones, deliverable schedules, and transparent retainer or project-based fee structures without hidden costs.

3

Technical Execution & Modeling

Our team constructs customized rolling financial forecasts, establishes internal control SOPs, or prepares tax and audit packages.

4

Monthly Steering & Variance Review

We conduct ongoing monthly or quarterly executive sessions to monitor budget variances and maintain continuous statutory compliance.

sections.h2: What Documents to Prepare Before Your Consultation
sections.contentHtml:
To maximize the value of your initial discovery session, having the following records ready is helpful:

  • Past 1 to 2 years of compiled Balance Sheets and P&L Statements (if existing business).
  • Recent 3 months of corporate bank statements and current debtor receivables summary.
  • PAN / VAT Registration certificate and latest tax clearance certificate.
  • Draft business plan or preliminary capital expenditure estimates (if founding a new venture).

faqs.question: Is there a fee for the initial diagnostic consultation?
faqs.answer: Our initial 45-minute discovery consultation is provided without commitment to determine mutual fit and outline recommended engagement scopes.

faqs.question: Are our company financials protected by confidentiality?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every consultation is governed by strict non-disclosure obligations, and our practice adheres to professional confidentiality standards.
